source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Check if system could power on with 1 PSU connected with power cable. Add PSU one by one and check if system could power on.
2. Boot system to OS with full PSU.
3. Remove power cable and PSU of 1st slot. And check if system is still normal or shutdown.
4. Plug PSU and power cable. Check LED of PSU.
5. Repeat steps 3~4 to all the reset of PSU.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. System should be unable to power on with 2PSU
2. System should not shutdowm when hot-remove one PSU
3. System should shutdowm when hot-remove two PSU

original_test_intent: Physically exercise the platform PSU population/redundancy rules by booting across approved PSU counts and removing/restoring PSU modules and cords while observing power continuity, shutdown and PSU LED behavior.
original_method: After the owner corrects the expected count matrix, a qualified operator populates and powers the approved configurations, boots with full PSU population, removes/restores named PSU modules and cords in the authorized order, and records physical power/LED plus BMC/host evidence at every state.
manual_activity: Installing/removing modules and cords and directly observing power/LED state are the core. Agent telemetry collection cannot substitute. No physical sequence may start until the conflicting two-PSU expectation is corrected.
required_inputs: Chassis PSU slot/serial/cord/AC-feed topology and redundancy rule
Approved hot-service/isolation sequence, load/workload scope and maintenance window
Expected power-on, OS continuity, shutdown, LED, BMC and SEL states at each matrix point
OOB recovery plan, qualified operator and one-user approval
safety_requirements: Do not guess whether two PSUs should or should not power the system; resolve the source contradiction first.
Do not remove a sole/required feed, multiple paths or the management recovery path outside the approved matrix.
Use vendor hot-plug rules and stop on unexpected shutdown, PSU/AC fault, heat, smoke or BMC loss.
Preserve per-step logs and physical evidence.
Do not automatically proceed to the next removal or retry after any unexpected state.
agent_execution_scope: Render the corrected count/removal matrix and capture baseline BMC/host/power evidence.
Wait for operator confirmation/photos for every population/removal/restoration state.
Collect phase-tagged PSU FRU/sensor/redundancy, SEL and host boot/reachability evidence.
Compare observed results to the corrected matrix without assigning the verdict.
engineer_actions: Correct/approve the count matrix and physical plan.
Perform all PSU/cord/population and power actions and visual observations.
Execute recovery/safety stop and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly non-runnable by the agent but incomplete: it assumes an undefined matrix and offers no BMC/host evidence method or correction for the contradictory 2PSU criterion.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After owner correction and each operator-confirmed state, use approved read-only BMC/host/power collection; no software command may replace physical PSU/AC changes.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Attended Time 60 and Machine Time 60 remain unchanged; no PSU count expectation is silently corrected.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create a state table for installed/energized PSU count, removed slots, expected boot/runtime/shutdown and LED/BMC results, then execute each authorized physical state once with synchronized evidence and recovery gates.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Only the named chassis power topology and PSU population.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record platform redundancy specification, PSU/BMC firmware and collection-tool versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Project/platform PSU redundancy and AC topology documents must resolve the source count error.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes each quantity/removal state explicit while retaining physical operations and both boot/runtime coverage.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Testing one-remove tolerance does not establish two-remove shutdown or reduced-population boot behavior; each matrix row is separate coverage.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Corrected matrix, topology, load, service rules, expected telemetry and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: An incorrect count/feed map can unexpectedly remove all usable power or management access.

project_override_considerations: A project override may define the correct PSU counts for its chassis, but must preserve the master conflict and report the exact states executed. Completing a subset cannot be claimed as the full quantity matrix.
expected_evidence: Owner correction and approved PSU/AC state matrix/topology
Per-state physical slot/serial/cord photos/checklist and LED/power observations
Phase-tagged BMC FRU/sensors/redundancy/SEL and host boot/reachability
Unexpected-state stop/recovery and final restored population

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The procedure begins with one PSU and adds units to test power-on, while criterion 1 says the system should be unable to power on with 2PSU. This is incompatible with the later one-removal survival/two-removal shutdown expectations unless a missing larger population rule is supplied.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The core is unequivocally a manual physical redundancy test. The contradictory expected count prevents readiness and verdict but does not change the MANUAL ONLY capability; it is tracked as NEEDS_ENGINEER_DECISION/SOURCE_CONFLICT rather than permanent automation BLOCKED.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Agree with human-only physical work; add the missing source conflict and evidence matrix.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agree with MANUAL ONLY and its hard pre-run correction, topology and recovery gates.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates automation capability from execution readiness and records the true contradiction without guessing a corrected count.

review_improvement: This review retains the full physical redundancy scope but refuses to guess the likely count typo, turning each approved population state into traceable evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: The physical core remains manual regardless of which count is correct. The conflict affects safe execution and expected outcomes, not whether a person must manipulate PSUs. Therefore MANUAL ONLY plus NEEDS_ENGINEER_DECISION is more precise than classifying every missing expected value as BLOCKED.
